pages.text: For safe storage of the experience, there is a carved nephrite. It is obtained from polished nephrite, which in turn is made from ordinary nephrite, which is already mined at the level of stone caves.

pages.title: Carved Nephrite
pages.text: Don't forget to read the block descriptions! Carved nephrite is able to accumulate experience within itself in the form of a charge that it distributes

between the neighboring carved nephrite. The charge will always be distributed downwards first before being distributed laterally, so keep this in mind when designing storage. Imagine that there is a liquid inside the block. Each block of carved nephrite can
accumulate 100 units of charge (that's just over 7 levels).

pages.title: Nephrite Siphon
pages.text: By placing it on a carved nephrite, it will allow you to suck in the experience and transfer it further into blocks. To do this, stand on it and wait or throw a bubble of experience into it.
Press Shift to make the process happen faster.

pages.title: Nephrite Fountain
pages.text: The fountain has the opposite mechanics. Put him on the nephrite, give him the redstone signal, after which he will start sucking experience out of the blocks.
RMB the working fountain with a bottle to get a bubble of experience.$(br2)The more carved nephrite there are with each other, the larger the storage volume. There are no limits.

When you break a carved nephrite containing experience charges, you will receive the exact number of experience points that were in it.$(br2)There is also a nephrite ring that can only be found in the Ancient City. Allows you to store up to 30 levels. RMB for use.
